description: This file contains utility functions and imports related to PyTorch's inductor runtime, including tensor size calculations, configuration validation, and helper functions for Triton and JAX integrations.

methods.name: conditional_product
methods.description: Calculates the product of multiple integer arguments, ignoring zeros.

methods.name: ceildiv
methods.description: Performs ceiling division of two integers.

methods.name: is_power_of_2
methods.description: Checks if a number is a power of two.

methods.name: next_power_of_2
methods.description: Returns the smallest power of two greater than or equal to a given number.

methods.name: last_power_of_2
methods.description: Returns the largest power of two less than or equal to a given number.

methods.name: get_num_bytes
methods.description: Calculates total bytes occupied by tensor arguments, considering in/out arguments.

methods.name: triton_config_to_hashable
methods.description: Converts a Triton config object into a hashable tuple for identification.

methods.name: validate_triton_config
methods.description: Validates that a Triton config does not have a pre_hook attached.

methods.name: create_bandwidth_info_str
methods.description: Creates a formatted string with bandwidth info, optionally colored if slow.

methods.name: get_max_y_grid
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y grid value for plotting.

methods.name: triton_hash_to_path_key
methods.description: Converts a Triton hash to a path key, using base64 or base32 encoding if available.

methods.name: compile_mps_shader
methods.description: Compiles a shader source for MPS, raising an error with context if compilation fails.

methods.name: torch_dtype_to_jax_runtime
methods.description: Maps a PyTorch dtype to the corresponding JAX dtype object at runtime.

methods.name: torch_dtype_to_jax
methods.description: Returns a string expression for the JAX dtype corresponding to a PyTorch dtype.

methods.name: pallas_partial_reduce
methods.description: Performs a partial reduction in JAX for Pallas kernels, reordering axes and reducing.
